mlb.award_narrative.assessment: Supersedes the MLB_a DUPLICATE verdict, which judged the earlier two-line 'regression of past winners on WAR rank' definition. The catalog definition was later rewritten (input_patches/MLB_a.json) into pre-registered, statistics-only flags (milestone, comeback, first_year, positional_scarcity, team_surprise) that enter mlb.award_vote_rank_model as additive worth terms, so it is a feature set, not the Plackett-Luce likelihood itself, and the catalog had already dropped the DUPLICATE flag. Re-judged by the baseline-reproducibility session (a Claude agent; NOT an independent re-audit and NOT human expert review). Open items kept visible: the raw_data list still names only winners/WAR ranks and team win%, but the measurement also needs season counting-stat tables, prior-season fWAR/PA/IP and a preseason ZiPS/PECOTA projected-wins archive; whether each flag adds likelihood is an empirical question. Baseline content deliberately unchanged.
